as_told.title: Lincoln LaPaz and the green fireballs

plain: Podcast host Jesse Michels says that in 1948 Lincoln LaPaz, a well-known meteor expert at the University of New Mexico, began studying "green fireballs", bright green lights seen in the sky. According to Michels, these fireballs often showed up near nuclear sites and nuclear test explosions. If that is true, it would suggest something was taking an interest in America's early atomic work.
